in_sanskrit.name: एकाग्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ekagra is derived from the Sanskrit word एकाग्र (ekāgra), which means 'one-pointed', 'focused', or 'undisturbed'. In Hindu mythology, Ekagra is the name of a sage who attained a one-pointed focus on his spiritual practice.

in_hindi.name: एकाग्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ekagra is composed of the Sanskrit words एक (eka), which means 'one', and ग्र (agra), which means 'focused' or 'undisturbed'. In Hindi, the name is written as एकाग्र (ekāgra).

in_tamil.name: ஏகாக்ர
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Ekagra is derived from the Tamil words ஏகம் (ēkam), which means 'one', and க்ரமம் (kramam), which means 'focused' or 'intense'. In this context, the name Ekagra can be interpreted as 'one-pointed focus' or 'intense focus'.

in_telugu.name: ేకఆగ్ర
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Ekagra is derived from the Telugu words ేకము (ēkamu), which means 'one', and ఆగ్రము (āgramu), which means 'focused' or 'intense'. In this context, the name Ekagra can be interpreted as 'one-pointed focus' or 'intense focus'.

in_marathi.name: Ekagra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekagra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekagra refers to one who has undivided attention, focus, and concentration towards a single goal or thought. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'eka' meaning 'one' and 'agra' meaning 'front' or 'highest'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also referred to as Ekagrya, signifying his unwavering devotion towards meditation and self-realization.
